rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides AI coding agents with access to the ArcAgent bounty marketplace through tools for browsing available bounties, claiming tasks, submitting code, and managing accounts. Submissions are verified inside isolated Firecracker microVMs through an 8-gate pipeline covering build, lint, typecheck, security, and test validation. Supports both local stdio transport via npx and a hosted streamable HTTP endpoint with stateful session management, rate limiting, and audit logging.
